caption: Usage Component
description: How one canonical usage component of an observation was established: reported (copied from one native member), derived exactly by a declared rule from named native members, or unavailable from what the source reported; and, where a declared rule establishes it, what the source establishes about the component's quantity (measured, possibly the source's default, or conditional on a possibly default operand).
name: usage_component

name.description: The canonical component attribute, for example uncached_input_tokens.

measurement_status_id.description: What the source establishes about this component's quantity, apart from component_basis_id; absent when no declared rule states it.

derivation.description: The declared rule and its arithmetic for a derived component, naming any possibly default operand it depends on; why the component is unavailable otherwise.
